name: Zheng He's first voyage
summary: The Yongle emperor sends a fleet of some 62 great treasure ships and many smaller vessels, with about 27,000 men, into the Western Ocean. It calls at Champa, Java and Sumatra, reaches Calicut on the Malabar coast, and comes home with envoys and a captured pirate king.

stops.note: The first fleet, with about 27,000 men, is assembled.
The fleet waits for the north-east monsoon.
Majapahit. Some 170 of the fleet's men are killed in a local war.
A sultanate at the northern tip of Sumatra.
Guli, 'the great country of the Western Ocean': the voyage's goal.
On the way home, defeats the pirate chief Chen Zuyi and takes him to Nanjing.
Home with envoys from Calicut and other kingdoms.
